declarations.title: Selected immutable ACR images have no detected secrets
declarations.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from image build inputs and layers, rebuild the image, and rotate confirmed exposed credentials.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in a selected immutable ACR image.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.

No cloud/auth/credential verification.
